hero.title: Restorative Dentistry
hero.description:
Restorative dentistry is about more than repairing teeth—it’s about restoring confidence, comfort, and long-term oral health.

Our services range from single-tooth solutions like crowns and tooth-colored fillings to complete full-mouth rehabilitation for complex cases, ensuring both functional efficiency and aesthetic harmony.

Implant restorations provide stable, lifelike replacements for missing teeth, supporting jaw health and overall oral structure.

Each treatment is planned with precision, taking into account the patient’s bite, oral health, and personal goals.

By combining advanced materials, modern techniques, and individualized care, our restorative dentistry helps patients regain the strength, appearance, and reliability of their smiles, allowing them to speak, eat, and smile confidently for years to come.

preview.name: Preventive Care
preview.title:
Preventive
Care
preview.description: Routine exams, cleanings, and screenings designed to maintain oral health and prevent issues before they arise.

hero.title: Preventive Care
hero.description:
Maintaining a healthy smile requires regular, proactive care. Our comprehensive preventive services are designed to detect potential issues early, protect your teeth and gums, and support your overall oral health.

During comprehensive exams, we carefully evaluate each aspect of your teeth, gums, and bite to identify concerns before they develop into larger problems.

Deep cleanings remove plaque and tartar from hard-to-reach areas, helping to prevent gum disease and maintain healthy tissue.

Fluoride treatments strengthen enamel and provide added protection against decay, while oral cancer screenings allow for early detection and prompt intervention, supporting your long-term health.

Routine prophies (professional cleanings) help maintain hygiene, remove surface stains, and preserve the natural brightness of your smile.

Together, these services provide a complete approach to preventive care, ensuring that your teeth, gums, and overall oral health are supported for a lifetime of confident smiles.

hero.title: Beyond the Smile
hero.description:
A confident smile is best supported by a face that feels balanced, refreshed, and naturally vibrant. Our facial aesthetic services—including Dysport® and dermal fillers—are designed to complement dentistry by enhancing harmony between the smile and surrounding features. These treatments are carefully tailored to soften lines, restore youthful contours, and refine overall appearance, always with a focus on subtlety and natural results.

With advanced training and a deep understanding of facial structure, our providers approach aesthetics with precision and artistry. Every treatment plan is thoughtfully customized, ensuring enhancements that feel elegant, refined, and true to the individual. The result is a refreshed, confident appearance that looks effortless.

Through Aventura Sleep, we address concerns that extend beyond oral health, including snoring, sleep apnea, and nighttime grinding. Our custom oral appliances are designed for comfort and ease of use while combining the latest scientific research with individualized treatment.

These solutions not only protect your smile but also improve sleep quality, overall energy, and long-term wellness. By tailoring every device to the unique needs of each patient, we ensure a discreet, effective, and comfortable approach to better sleep and better health.

technologies.name: iTero Digital Impressions
technologies.heroDescription: iTero is an advanced 3D scanning technology that replaces traditional dental impressions with fast, highly accurate digital imaging.
technologies.previewDescription: Precise digital impressions of your teeth and bite, allowing for accurate, comfortable, and efficient treatment planning.

about.title: What it is
about.description: The iTero Element 5D is advanced digital impression system that captures highly accurate, 3D images of your teeth, gums, and bite. Unlike traditional putty impressions, the iTero uses a small, handheld wand to scan your mouth, creating a detailed digital model instantly. These scans are used for designing restorations, orthodontic treatments, and other dental procedures with unmatched precision and efficiency.

about.title: Whe We Use It
about.description: We use the iTero to provide faster, more comfortable, and highly accurate dental care. By creating precise digital impressions, we can plan treatments more efficiently, reduce the need for physical molds, and ensure restorations and orthodontic appliances fit perfectly. This technology also allows patients to see a digital preview of their smile, enhancing understanding and confidence in their treatment plan.

benefits: Captures precise 3D digital impressions of teeth and bite.
Eliminates the need for traditional putty molds
Ensures accurate fit for restorations and orthodontics
Allows patients to preview their smile digitally

technologies.name: Solea Laser
technologies.heroDescription:
The Solea Laser is a state-of-the-art dental laser that allows us to perform a wide range of procedures with unparalleled precision and minimal discomfort. From cavity removal and gum reshaping to soft tissue procedures, Solea provides faster, more accurate treatment while reducing the need for anesthesia, stitches, and traditional dental drills.

By combining cutting-edge technology with expert technique, the Solea Laser ensures that treatments are not only effective but also more comfortable, efficient, and predictable. Patients experience less anxiety, faster healing, and exceptional results, all while enjoying a modern, gentle approach to dental care.
technologies.previewDescription: The Solea Laser delivers precise, comfortable dental treatment with minimal anesthesia, faster healing, and exceptional results.

about.title: What it is
about.description: The Solea Laser uses advanced CO₂ technology to perform dental treatments with unmatched precision and comfort. By replacing traditional drills and needles, it allows for faster, virtually painless procedures—giving patients a quieter, more relaxed experience with exceptional results.

about.title: Whe We Use It
about.description: The Solea Laser uses advanced CO₂ technology to perform dental treatments with unmatched precision and comfort. By replacing traditional drills and needles, it allows for faster, virtually painless procedures—giving patients a quieter, more relaxed experience with exceptional results.

benefits: Performs procedures without anesthesia and discomfort
Reduces bleeding, swelling, and healing time
Allows precise treatment for hard and soft tissue
Enhances patient comfort and treatment efficiency

technologies.name: Intra Oral Camera
technologies.heroDescription: We use intraoral cameras to enhance both accuracy and patient communication. By visually displaying your teeth and gums, we can detect problems earlier and plan treatments more effectively. Patients gain a clear understanding of their oral health and the steps needed to protect and improve it. This technology ensures that every procedure—from routine care to advanced restorations, is guided by real-time, high-definition imagery, improving outcomes and providing transparency throughout your dental experience.
technologies.previewDescription: Detailed views of your teeth and gums, helping us detect issues early and plan treatments with accuracy.

about.title: What Is It?
about.description: An intraoral camera is a small, high-definition camera that captures detailed images of the inside of your mouth. Unlike traditional X-rays, these cameras provide color images in real time, allowing both the dentist and patient to see areas of concern immediately. They can highlight cavities, cracks, worn areas, and gum issues, making diagnosis and treatment planning faster, more precise, and easier to understand.

about.title: Why We Use It?
about.description: We use intraoral cameras to enhance both accuracy and patient communication. By visually displaying your teeth and gums, we can detect problems earlier and plan treatments more effectively. Patients gain a clear understanding of their oral health and the steps needed to protect and improve it. This technology ensures that every procedure, from routine care to advanced restorations—is guided by real-time, high-definition imagery, improving outcomes and providing transparency throughout your dental experience.

benefits: Provides real-time, detailed views inside the mouth
Helps detect cavities, cracks, and gum issues early
Makes diagnosis and treatment planning more precise

technologies.name: Digital Imaging
technologies.heroDescription: Our advanced digital imaging technology allows us to see every detail of your smile with remarkable clarity. From early detection of dental concerns to precise treatment planning, these high-resolution images empower both you and our doctors to make confident, informed decisions. Experience a new level of transparency, accuracy, and personalized care, where every aspect of your oral health is captured and understood.
technologies.previewDescription: Crystal-clear digital imaging for precise, personalized dental care

about.title: What it is
about.description: Digital imaging in dentistry uses state-of-the-art sensors and software to capture detailed pictures of your teeth, gums, and surrounding structures. Unlike traditional film X-rays, digital images are immediate, highly detailed, and easily enhanced or magnified to reveal subtle issues. These images include 2D X-rays, intraoral scans, and other high-resolution imaging tools, allowing our team to evaluate your oral health with accuracy and clarity.

about.title: Whe We Use It
about.description: We use digital imaging to ensure that every diagnosis and treatment plan is based on the most precise information available. The technology helps us detect cavities, bone loss, gum disease, and other conditions early, often before symptoms appear. It also allows us to plan procedures with confidence, improving the accuracy, safety, and predictability of restorations, implants, and other dental treatments. For patients, this means fewer surprises, more comfortable care, and results that are both functional and beautifully natural.

benefits: Captures high-resolution images for accurate diagnostics
Reveals cavities, gum disease, and bone loss early
Enhances treatment planning and outcome predictability
Immediate results with minimal radiation exposure

technologies.name: CAD/CAM Restorations
technologies.heroDescription: Experience the future of dentistry with CAD/CAM restorations— allowing us to design and create custom restorations with exceptional accuracy and aesthetic harmony. Each piece is digitally sculpted to blend seamlessly with your natural smile — combining innovation, artistry, and lasting strength.
technologies.previewDescription: Digitally crafted restorations for precise fit, natural beauty, and lasting strength

about.title: What it is
about.description: CAD/CAM restorations are custom dental restorations designed and crafted using advanced digital technology. CAD (Computer-Aided Design) allows us to create precise digital models of your teeth, while CAM (Computer-Aided Manufacturing) transforms these designs into high-quality restorations with exceptional accuracy. This process enables the creation of crowns, bridges, veneers, and inlays that are tailored to the exact shape, color, and function of your natural teeth, ensuring seamless integration with your smile.

about.title: Whe We Use It
about.description: We use CAD/CAM technology to provide restorations that are both highly precise and beautifully natural. By designing restorations digitally, we can minimize errors, achieve perfect fit and occlusion, and create results that blend flawlessly with your teeth. This technology also allows us to work efficiently while maintaining the highest standards of quality, strength, and aesthetics. For patients, this means restorations that look and feel like natural teeth, last longer, and support optimal oral health.

benefits: Digitally designed for perfect fit and function
Custom-crafted to blend seamlessly with natural teeth
Combines strength, precision, and esthetic beauty
Efficient production with high-quality, durable results

technologies.name: 3D CAT Scan
technologies.heroDescription: Our advanced dental CAT scan technology provides a complete, three-dimensional view of your teeth, bone, and surrounding structures. With this level of detail, we can plan treatments with unmatched accuracy from implants and surgeries to diagnostics and smile design, ensuring safer, more predictable, and beautifully precise results.
technologies.previewDescription: A detailed 3D view of your teeth, jaw, and bone structure, helping us plan treatments with precision, safety, and confidence.

about.title: What it is
about.description: A dental CAT scan, also called a cone beam CT scan, is an advanced 3D imaging tool that captures a detailed view of your teeth, jawbone, nerves, and surrounding structures. Unlike traditional X-rays, which provide only flat, two-dimensional images, a CAT scan allows us to see your oral anatomy from multiple angles, revealing hidden details such as bone density, tooth positioning, and sinus pathways. This high-resolution imaging is quick, comfortable, and performed with low radiation exposure, giving us a clear, complete picture of your oral health in a single scan.

about.title: Why We Use It
about.description: We use dental CAT scans to transform this detailed 3D information into safer, more effective, and highly personalized treatment plans. By understanding the exact position of teeth, bone, and nerves, we can plan complex procedures—such as implants, extractions, or full-mouth restorations—with unparalleled accuracy. The scan allows us to detect issues that might not appear on standard X-rays, catch potential problems early, and minimize risks during treatment. Most importantly, it enables us to tailor every procedure to the unique structure of each patient’s mouth, ensuring that every restoration or surgery is not only functional but also beautifully precise and customized to their smile.

benefits: Provides detailed 3D images of teeth, jaw, and bone
Detects hidden issues invisible on standard X-rays
Guides precise implant and surgical planning
Enhances safety and predictability of treatments

If you want QUALITY definitely come hither. If you want honesty, integrity, and assurance, don't hesitate.

faqs.question: How often should dental X-rays be taken?
faqs.answer: It depends on oral health, age, and medical history. Typically, healthy patients may need them every 1–2 years; those at higher risk may require more frequent imaging.

faqs.question: How often should I visit the dentist?
faqs.answer: Most patients benefit from a checkup and professional cleaning every six months. Those with gum disease or other dental conditions may need more frequent visits.

faqs.question: Is it possible to restore teeth without fillings or crowns?
faqs.answer: In some cases, yes — for example, using veneers or composite restorations if the damage is minor.

faqs.question: What is a veneer and when is it recommended?
faqs.answer: A veneer is a thin covering, usually ceramic or porcelain, applied to the front surface of a tooth to improve its shape, color, or mask imperfections.

faqs.question: How long do crowns, bridges, or implants last?
faqs.answer: With proper care, they often last 10–15 years or longer. Regular check-ups and good oral hygiene are essential to maintain their longevity.

faqs.question: How long does a teeth whitening procedure take?
faqs.answer: Usually 1–2 hours in the clinic. Results depend on the initial tooth color and depth of discoloration.

faqs.question: Are there alternatives to strong whitening agents?
faqs.answer: Yes — home whitening systems with lower concentrations, LED lights, or special polishing/paste products can be used under professional guidance.

faqs.question: Is special care required after getting a crown or bridge?
faqs.answer: Yes — regular brushing, flossing, use of interdental brushes, and routine check-ups are recommended to maintain gum health and prevent damage to the restoration.

faqs.question: How much does treatment cost?
faqs.answer: Costs depend on the procedure, complexity, and materials used. A detailed estimate is always provided after consultation and diagnosis.

faqs.question: Can I see a 3D scan or digital impression before my restoration is made?
faqs.answer: Yes — modern digital scans allow visualization of the expected result, coordination with our in-house dental lab, and help avoid errors.

faqs.question: What should I expect during my first visit?
faqs.answer: Your initial visit includes a comprehensive evaluation, digital imaging, and a detailed discussion of your concerns and goals. This appointment is designed to provide clarity, education, and a clear path forward—without pressure.

faqs.question: Do you provide anesthesia or pain relief for complex procedures?
faqs.answer: Yes, local anesthesia or Nitrous Oxide is available for comfort during treatment. Sedation options may also be available depending on the procedure and patient preference.

faqs.question: Does Aventura Dental Arts accept new patients, and is an appointment required?
faqs.answer: Yes, Aventura Dental Arts welcomes new patients with open arms. Booking in advance is recommended, especially for specialized treatments.

faqs.question: Does scaling or professional cleaning hurt?
faqs.answer: It may be slightly uncomfortable, especially if there is significant tartar or gum inflammation, but with our trained hygienist's gentle touch, most patients manage it well and feel much fresher afterward.

faqs.question: What foods should I avoid after my procedure?
faqs.answer: You may be advised to avoid hard, sticky, or hot foods for a short period. Specific dietary guidelines will be provided based on your treatment.

faqs.question: What should I do if I experience sensitivity or swelling?
faqs.answer: Mild sensitivity or swelling can be normal. If symptoms persist or worsen, please contact our office so we can evaluate and assist you promptly.

faqs.question: When is payment due for my treatment?
faqs.answer: Payment is typically due at the time of service unless prior arrangements have been made.

faqs.question: How far in advance should I schedule my appointment?
faqs.answer: We recommend scheduling as early as possible, especially for consultations or extended treatment visits. This allows us to reserve adequate time and ensure continuity of care.

faqs.question: What happens if I arrive late to my appointment?
faqs.answer: Arriving late may limit the time available for your visit or require rescheduling. Out of respect for all patients, we strive to keep our schedule running on time and appreciate advance notice if delays occur.

faqs.question: What technology do you use in your practice?
faqs.answer: We use advanced 3D imaging, digital scanners, laser dentistry, and intraoral cameras to ensure precision, comfort, and a more efficient experience.

teams.name: Dr. Melanie Silvestrini
teams.shortBio: Expert in esthetic dentistry, implants, and full-mouth rehabilitations.
teams.bio:
Dr. Silvestrini is a powerhouse of talent and dedication, combining advanced dental expertise with an artist’s eye for detail. Raised in New York City, she’s built a reputation not only for her technical skill but for her relentless drive to deliver smile transformations that truly change lives.

A graduate of Tufts University’s DMD program, Dr. Silvestrini took her training to the next level with specialized studies at Northwell Health, mastering everything from complex oral diagnosis to full-mouth restorations. She’s equally at home designing flawless veneers or creating personalized treatment plans that balance function, beauty, and long-term health—always with the latest tech at her fingertips.
But dentistry is only part of her story. Dr. Silvestrini’s expertise extends into facial aesthetics, where she uses neurotoxins and dermal fillers to complement her dental work, enhance natural beauty, and help patients manage TMJ discomfort. This holistic approach reflects her belief that confidence comes from more than just a smile.

Never one to rest on her laurels, Dr. Silvestrini actively shares her knowledge through research awards, international presentations, and as the engaging host of Dental Talk 360. Outside the clinic, she’s deeply committed to community service and global pro bono efforts, bringing quality care to underserved youth worldwide.

At Aventura Dental Arts, Dr. Silvestrini stands out for her fierce work ethic, sharp clinical acumen, and a genuine passion for making every patient’s journey exceptional—inside and out.

teams.name: Dr. Javier Scarton
teams.bio:
Dr. Javier Scarton has a rare gift for blending precision, artistry, and genuine care—a combination that defines his approach to prosthodontics and restorative dentistry. Born and raised in Venezuela, he brings over a decade of specialized experience and a passion for transforming smiles with natural beauty and lasting function.

Graduating cum laude from the University of Carabobo, Dr. Scarton’s pursuit of excellence took him across continents—from advanced prosthodontics studies in Barcelona to further refinement at the University of Southern California, where he earned a coveted OKU Zeta Chapter Scholarship. But beyond accolades, it’s his thoughtful attention to each patient’s unique needs and aspirations that truly sets him apart.

At Aventura Dental Arts, Dr. Scarton is known for his careful, personalized approach—whether he’s designing porcelain veneers, crafting all-ceramic crowns, or orchestrating full-mouth restorations. He listens deeply, tailoring every detail to harmonize with each person’s facial structure and lifestyle, ensuring that the final smile feels as natural as it looks radiant. His dedication extends far beyond the clinic. Dr. Scarton continually embraces the latest innovations through international conferences and collaborative study groups, eager to bring cutting-edge techniques directly to his patients. Yet his humility and warmth remain constant—patients feel not just treated, but truly cared for.
With Dr. Scarton, precision meets passion, expertise meets empathy, and every smile is a carefully crafted reflection of the individual behind it.

teams.name: Dr. Laura Lugo
teams.shortBio: Expert in esthetic dentistry, implants, and full-mouth rehabilitations.
teams.bio:
Dr. Laura Lugo’s path in dentistry reflects a deep passion and dedication to her craft. After earning her dental degree from Universidad de Carabobo in Venezuela, she began her career working closely with Dr. Nuria Otero, building a strong foundation in prosthodontics and esthetic dentistry.

Before dental school, Dr. Lugo developed invaluable technical skills as a dental technician and assistant under the mentorship of renowned ceramist Rafael Santrich. This unique experience gives her a finely tuned eye for detail and a hands-on understanding of dental artistry.

Since relocating to the United States, Dr. Lugo completed her residency at Nova Southeastern University, further enhancing her expertise in advanced esthetic restorations, surgical extractions, and comprehensive dental care. Her commitment to continuous education has taken her to Brazil and Colombia for advanced training, and she has collaborated on publications alongside Dr. Javier Scarton and Dr. Otero.

Known for her gentle and compassionate approach, Dr. Lugo prioritizes patient comfort and individualized care. She strives to ensure that every treatment not only achieves outstanding clinical results but also feels thoughtful and reassuring to each patient.

At Aventura Dental Arts, Dr. Lugo is valued not only for her clinical skills but also for the trust and calm she brings to every patient’s experience, making her a vital part of the ADA team and a trusted caregiver in the community.

teams.name: Dr. Nuria Otero
teams.shortBio: ADA Partner and prosthodontist, brings over 20 years of world-class expertise and artistic precision to transform complex dental cases into naturally harmonious, confident smiles.
teams.bio:
With over 20 years of experience in advanced restorative and esthetic dentistry, Dr. Nuria Otero is a cornerstone of Aventura Dental Arts and one of South Florida’s most respected prosthodontists. Known for her exquisite full-mouth reconstructions and artistic veneer work, Dr. Otero has earned a reputation for transforming complex dental challenges into functional, breathtaking smiles.

Although originally from Venezuela, Dr. Otero began her career with a Doctor of Dental Surgery degree before relocating to the United States to refine her expertise at Boston University’s prestigious Goldman School of Dental Medicine. There, she completed a Master of Science in Dentistry along with a Certificate of Advanced Graduate Studies in Prosthodontics, one of the most rigorous prosthodontic programs in the world. She later returned to Venezuela and opened her own successful practice. Her exceptional clinical acumen earned her the David Baraban Award, an honor given for both academic distinction and clinical excellence.

At Aventura Dental Arts, Dr. Otero focuses on full-mouth rehabilitations, porcelain veneers, ceramic restorations, and implant-supported prosthetics. She’s known for her ability to create natural, harmonious results—even in the most complex cases. Her approach is thoughtful and detailed, always balancing function, esthetics, and long-term health. Whether rebuilding a smile from the ground up or refining small imperfections, her work reflects both technical excellence and artistic vision.

Beyond her practice, Dr. Otero is a respected voice in the global dental community. She has lectured internationally on esthetic materials, ceramic artistry, and digital workflows, and her work has been published in leading journals such as Quintessence International and The International Journal of Periodontics & Restorative Dentistry. She is also an active member of the American Dental Association, the Florida Dental Association.

Patients appreciate Dr. Otero for her calm presence, warm communication, and genuine dedication to delivering exceptional care. She brings clarity to complex treatment plans and always takes the time to ensure patients feel informed and confident throughout their journey. With her expertise and eye for esthetics, she continues to elevate the standard of care at Aventura Dental Arts.

teams.name: Dr. Luke Grillo
teams.shortBio: Expert in esthetic dentistry, implants, and full-mouth rehabilitations.
teams.bio:
Patients enjoy working with Dr. Luke due to his calm, easy going personality, patience, and passionate dedication to his craft. He believes that true excellence lives in the precision and the minute details. These factors allow him to provide the highest quality comprehensive dentistry, while helping the patient feel understood and their position valued.

Dr. Luke’s journey in dentistry began over 25 years ago at Aventura Dental Arts, where he first shadowed his father, Dr. Larry Grillo. From an early age, he was immersed in the world of dentistry, building experience under the mentorships of multiple premier specialists throughout South Florida. He earned his Bachelor of Science in Nutritional Sciences from the University of Florida, where he also helped lead dental mission trips to Georgetown, Guyana, and took part in annual Florida Mission of Mercy outreach programs. He went on to complete a Master’s in Biomedical Sciences with honors at Barry University, interning at VM Lab Technologies and Blum-Nico Oral Facial Surgery Associates—further deepening his clinical foundations. Dr. Luke then earned his DMD from Tufts University School of Dental Medicine, graduating on the dean’s list in the top 5% of his class, all while continuing to work in fitness and nutrition.

Over the past few years, Dr. Luke has built a loyal patient base in Boston who praise his ability to ease dental anxiety through relationship-based care and by delivering beautiful smiles. He takes the time to listen, understand his patients' concerns, and create treatment plans that are not only functional and aesthetic, but also holistic and health-affirming.
With a strong background in nutrition, biomedical science, and a lifelong commitment to health and wellness, Dr. Luke views dentistry through a comprehensive lens. His approach integrates sleep health, function, esthetics and long-term well-being—empowering patients to improve more than just their smiles. Whether it’s a routine exam or a complex, multidisciplinary full-mouth rehabilitation, Dr. Luke is committed to delivering life-changing results with precision and compassion.

teams.name: Dr. Larry Grillo
teams.shortBio: Founder of ADA, combines over 30 years of clinical expertise with a passion for patient care, artistry, and lasting results in general and cosmetic dentistry.
teams.bio:
Dr. Larry Grillo is the founding force behind Aventura Dental Arts, where he has set the standard for excellence in general and cosmetic dentistry for over three decades. As the original visionary of the practice, Dr. Grillo has built a reputation for combining advanced clinical expertise with an unwavering commitment to patient care.

A graduate of the University of Texas at San Antonio Dental School, Dr. Grillo went on to complete advanced implant training through a residency at the University of Miami. He is widely respected for his work in esthetic dentistry, full-mouth rehabilitation, and interdisciplinary treatment planning. His approach emphasizes natural, lasting results—blending artistry with precision in procedures such as porcelain veneers, ceramic restorations, and implant-supported solutions.

Dr. Grillo is not only a skilled clinician, but also a mentor, lecturer, and collaborator who continues to shape the future of dentistry through education and professional partnerships. His leadership, integrity, and passion for patient transformation have earned him a loyal following and the deep respect of peers across the field.

Outside the practice, he’s just as full of life—an adventurer, family man, and storyteller who finds joy in the small moments and gives fully in everything he does. Dr. Grillo has been married to his beautiful wife, Katie for 32 years, and is the proud father of 5 children- Noah, Luke, Savannah, Jonah, and Gabriel.

teams.name: Dr. Joel Gale
teams.shortBio: Senior partner at Aventura Dental Arts, brings nearly 3 decades of expertise in cosmetic and restorative dentistry, combining meticulous precision with genuine care to create naturally beautiful, lasting smiles.
teams.bio:
When patients describe Dr. Joel Gale, the words that often surface first are “meticulous,” “genuine,” and “deeply caring.” As a senior partner at Aventura Dental Arts and one of South Florida’s most respected cosmetic dentists, Dr. Gale has spent nearly three decades building a practice rooted in precision, trust, and a deep dedication to the art of smile design.

Dr. Gale’s path in dentistry began at the University of Maryland, where he earned his Bachelor of Science, followed by graduating at the top of his class from Boston University School of Dentistry. He later refined his expertise at Tufts University School of Dental Medicine, focusing on advanced cosmetic and esthetic techniques, including porcelain veneers, all-ceramic restorations, implants, and full-mouth rehabilitations. A true South Florida native, Dr. Gale returned home, bringing his talents to Aventura.

While his credentials speak volumes, it’s Dr. Gale’s approach that truly sets him apart. He brings a calm, approachable energy to each consultation, combining clinical excellence with a collaborative spirit that helps patients feel seen, heard, and confident in their care. He’s exacting when it comes to detail, every angle, shade, and contour matters but never at the expense of empathy or connection.

Over the years, Dr. Gale’s reputation for crafting beautifully natural, camera-ready smiles has earned him the trust of a wide-ranging clientele, including A-list celebrities, public figures, and international patients who travel across continents to sit in his chair. Yet no matter who walks through his doors, Dr. Gale’s focus remains the same: deliver world-class dentistry with warmth, intention, and integrity.

In every smile he restores, there’s a quiet signature, one that reflects decades of experience, a devotion to innovation, and a belief that great dentistry is never just about the outcome, it’s about how you make someone feel along the way.

Outside of the office, Dr. Gale is a devoted husband to his wife, Julie, and a proud father to his two sons, Jake and Dylan.
